title: Development and Characterization of LasR Immobilized Monolithic Column for Screening Active Ingredients as Quorum Sensing Inhibitors Against P. aeruginosa in Natural Products.
authors: Liu, Zheng; Yang, Yue; Xie, Xiaoyuan; Li, Rui; You, Jifeng; Zhao, Xianglong; Wang, Yuanyuan; Guo, Jialiang
one_liner_zh: 该文利用LasR蛋白固定化整体柱筛选天然产物中的群体感应抑制剂，虽涉及蛋白-配体亲和与分子对接，但对象为蛋白-小分子而非蛋白质-DNA互作，且无AI或MD方法，仅边缘相关。
abstract: BACKGROUND AND AIM: The enzyme/protein immobilized monolithic capillary combined with liquid chromatography-mass spectrometry is an efficient screening strategy for the corresponding agonist/antagonist. LasR is the potential therapeutic target since it plays a vital role in the colonization and invasion of Pseudomonas aeruginosa (P. aeruginosa). Therefore, reagents that inhibit LasR may be effective against P. aeruginosa. To screen and find LasR inhibitors rapidly, a LasR-immobilized monolithic capillary column was prepared and characterized. METHODS: Firstly, the recombinant LasR protein was prepared in E. coli. Then, the LasR protein was immobilized to the surface of poly (glycidyl methacrylate-co-poly(ethylene glycol)diacrylate)-ethylenediamine monolithic column. The affinity and stability of prepared column was also evaluated. Furthermore, the prepared column was applied to fishing LasR inhibitor in Scutellaria baicalensis Georgi extract. The interaction of the screening compound to LasR was confirmed through molecular docking. RESULTS: The recombinant active LasR protein was prepared in E. coli. After purification and validation, a comparative ligand fishing monolithic column was prepared through immobilizing LasR to the surface of the poly (glycidyl methacrylate-co-poly(ethylene glycol)diacrylate)-ethylenediamine through amidation reaction. The LasR was successfully immobilized to the monolithic column characterizing by Fourier transform infrared spectroscopy and scanning electron microscopy. The activity of immobilized LasR was reserved as it has affinity to the nature ligand 3-oxo-C(12)-HSL and stablied within 24 h at 4  degrees C. In the Scutellaria baicalensis Georgi extract, baicalein was screened as a potential LasR inhibitor. The molecular docking results and the in vivo evaluation confirmed the activity of baicalein. CONCLUSION: The proposed LasR immobilized monolithic column is a viable strategy in screening LasR inhibitors. It can be considered as a possible alternative to traditional methods for screening LasR inhibitors as drug candidates against P. aeruginosa.
abstract_zh: 背景与目的：酶/蛋白固定化整体柱结合液相色谱-质谱是一种针对相应激动剂/拮抗剂的高效筛选策略。LasR在铜绿假单胞菌（P. aeruginosa）的定植和侵袭中发挥重要作用，因此是潜在的治疗靶点。抑制LasR的试剂可能对铜绿假单胞菌有效。为快速筛选并发现LasR抑制剂，制备并表征了一种LasR固定化整体毛细管柱。方法：首先，在大肠杆菌（E. coli）中制备重组LasR蛋白。然后，将LasR蛋白固定到聚（甲基丙烯酸缩水甘油酯-co-聚乙二醇二丙烯酸酯）-乙二胺整体柱表面。评估了所制备柱的亲和力和稳定性。此外，将所制备柱应用于黄芩（Scutellaria baicalensis Georgi）提取物中LasR抑制剂的钓取。通过分子对接确认了筛选化合物与LasR的相互作用。结果：在大肠杆菌中制备了具有活性的重组LasR蛋白。经纯化和验证后，通过酰胺化反应将LasR固定到聚（甲基丙烯酸缩水甘油酯-co-聚乙二醇二丙烯酸酯）-乙二胺表面，制备了配体钓取整体柱。通过傅里叶变换红外光谱和扫描电子显微镜表征，确认LasR成功固定到整体柱上。固定化LasR的活性得以保留，因其对天然配体3-oxo-C(12)-HSL具有亲和力，并在4°C下稳定24小时。在黄芩提取物中，黄芩素被筛选为潜在的LasR抑制剂。分子对接结果和体内评价确认了黄芩素的活性。结论：所提出的LasR固定化整体柱是筛选LasR抑制剂的一种可行策略，可被视为传统方法筛选抗铜绿假单胞菌药物候选LasR抑制剂的潜在替代方案。
